description: This file implements a memory management module for short-term promotion, including data structures, lock handling, file I/O, and promotion logic for memory entries in a project related to openclaw.

methods.name: clampScore
methods.description: Clamps a numeric score between 0 and 1, returns 0 for non-finite values.

methods.name: toFiniteScore
methods.description: Converts a value to a finite number between 0 and 1, with fallback.

methods.name: normalizeSnippet
methods.description: Trims and normalizes whitespace in a snippet string.

methods.name: normalizeMemoryPath
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with slashes and removes leading './' from a path.

methods.name: buildEntryKey
methods.description: Builds a unique key for a memory entry based on path, lines, and source.

methods.name: hashQuery
methods.description: Creates a SHA-1 hash of a query string, truncated to 12 characters.

methods.name: mergeQueryHashes
methods.description: Merges a new query hash into existing hashes, maintaining a maximum size.

methods.name: mergeRecentDistinct
methods.description: Merges a new date into a list of recent dates, maintaining order and limit.

methods.name: normalizeIsoDay
methods.description: Normalizes a string to ISO date format (YYYY-MM-DD).

methods.name: normalizeDistinctStrings
methods.description: Normalizes an array of strings, trimming and deduplicating up to a limit.

methods.name: calculateConsolidationComponent
methods.description: Calculates a consolidation score based on recall days.

methods.name: calculateConceptualComponent
methods.description: Calculates a conceptual score based on number of concept tags.

methods.name: emptyStore
methods.description: Creates an empty recall store with current timestamp.

methods.name: normalizeStore
methods.description: Normalizes raw data into a structured recall store.

methods.name: toFinitePositive
methods.description: Converts a value to a positive finite number with fallback.

methods.name: toFiniteNonNegativeInt
methods.description: Converts a value to a non-negative integer with fallback.

methods.name: normalizeWeights
methods.description: Normalizes promotion weights to sum to 1.

methods.name: calculateRecencyComponent
methods.description: Calculates recency decay based on age and half-life.

methods.name: resolveStorePath
methods.description: Resolves the file path for the recall store based on workspace directory.

methods.name: resolveLockPath
methods.description: Resolves the file path for the lock file based on workspace directory.

methods.name: parseLockOwnerPid
methods.description: Parses the PID from lock file content.

methods.name: isProcessLikelyAlive
methods.description: Checks if a process with given PID is likely alive.

methods.name: canStealStaleLock
methods.description: Determines if a stale lock can be stolen based on process liveness.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Asynchronous sleep for specified milliseconds.

methods.name: withShortTermLock
methods.description: Executes a task with a file lock, handling stale locks and retries.

methods.name: readStore
methods.description: Reads and normalizes the recall store from disk.

methods.name: writeStore
methods.description: Writes the recall store to disk atomically.

methods.name: isShortTermMemoryPath
methods.description: Checks if a file path matches short-term memory patterns.

methods.name: recordShortTermRecalls
methods.description: Records recall results into short-term memory store.

methods.name: rankShortTermPromotionCandidates
methods.description: Ranks memory entries as candidates for promotion based on scoring criteria.

methods.name: buildPromotionSection
methods.description: Builds a markdown section listing promoted candidates.

methods.name: withTrailingNewline
methods.description: Ensures a string ends with a newline.

methods.name: applyShortTermPromotions
methods.description: Applies promotion to selected memory entries and updates the store.

methods.name: resolveShortTermRecallStorePath
methods.description: Resolves the recall store path for a workspace.

methods.name: resolveShortTermRecallLockPath
methods.description: Resolves the lock file path for a workspace.

methods.name: auditShortTermPromotionArtifacts
methods.description: Audits the recall store and lock for issues, returning a summary.

methods.name: repairShortTermPromotionArtifacts
methods.description: Repairs issues in the recall store and lock, fixing invalid entries and stale locks.
